title: The Room
blurb: You have the job. Now you have one grey Saturday, and a week's pay you can't afford to lose, to find somewhere to live in a city that still doesn't know you.

identity.name: Rope-Works Winter
identity.mood: A cold bright city by day; one lit doorway with a warm room behind it.

line.en: You have the job. Now you need a room.
line.fr: Vous avez le travail. Il vous faut maintenant une chambre.
line.es: Ya tienes el trabajo. Ahora necesitas una habitación.
line.it: Hai il lavoro. Adesso ti serve una stanza.
line.de: Du hast die Stelle. Jetzt brauchst du ein Zimmer.
line.pt: Já tens o emprego. Agora precisas de um quarto.
line.zh: 工作有了。现在你需要一个房间。
line.ar: حصلت على العمل. الآن تحتاج إلى غرفة.
